provenance: Locally authored fictional text previews. No real documents, file contents, API responses or private data. Evaluation includes cross-topic titles; these are illustrative examples, not a public benchmark.
policy: Finance: payments, receipts, accounting and budgets. People: hiring, employee leave, benefits and reviews. Projects: software bugs, designs, features and releases. Classify the work requested, not the department words in the title.

limitations: Authored fictional previews, not a representative document benchmark.
Expected folders implement the displayed sample policy, not arbitrary personal preferences.
Check labels calibrate review behavior; only the separate new batch is evaluation.
A confident prediction can still be wrong; no production readiness claim.
No PDF extraction, OCR, filesystem actions or automatic desktop observation.

environment.backend: NumPy CPU; TF-IDF; cache off; receipts off
environment.timing_scope: Teaching measures projector fit plus compilation/calibration, excluding skill save/reload and human filing. Prediction includes text projection and strict decision; excludes startup, HTTP, browser rendering and downstream work.
